policy.principle: Third-party runtimes remain execution surfaces; MindCore owns policy, routing, audit and promotion.
policy.security: Credentials, browser sessions, filesystem roots and process execution stay behind explicit execution domains.

tools.integration: Graft graph/context operations are exposed through the MindCore capability contract.
OpenMontage is attached as a supervised production workspace; planning, research, scripting, rendering and validation remain auditable task operations.
Local MCP code intelligence is exposed through typed structural-query operations; repository indexing is gated.
Supervised browser automation capability with isolated browser sessions and explicit action approval.
Persistent cross-agent memory is exposed through typed memory operations; storage remains in the memory execution domain.
Agent Skills-compatible scientific workflows are discoverable and executable through a supervised research workspace.
Editorial HTML/SVG diagram generation and redraws become evidence-linked visualization artifacts.
Structured security skills are available to authorized defensive and security-research workflows behind the admin approval gate.
tools.security: authorized systems only; no unrestricted credentials or autonomous production changes

tools.integration: Harness patterns are indexed as a reference layer for evaluating orchestration, context, tool design, constraints and safe autonomy.
Context is exposed through an inspectable filesystem-oriented interface for knowledge, memory and skills.
